title: Staff AccountantQualifications & Requirements Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in general accounting. Advanced English proficiency, both written and verbal is a MUST Strong knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and computerized spreadsheets. Experience working with accounting software or ERP systems. Knowledge of JD Edwards is preferred. Experience with account reconciliations, financial analysis, and month-end closing activities. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Key Competencies Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving Attention to Detail Integrity & Accountability Planning & Organization Effective Communication & Teamwork Why Join Hunter Industries? At Hunter Industries, you'll have the opportunity to grow professionally in an international manufacturing environment, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to financial processes that support our business operations.
